correctness.rationale: On the normalized monomial basis the operator is an orthogonal weighted shift with singular weights (j!/(j-k)!) exp(-h(j-k)) ((j-k+m+1)/(j+1))^beta, j>=k; infinite sum of their p powers is exact by T*T diagonalization. Direct derivative bounds show strict concavity of continuous logarithmic weight, maximizer x_h=k/h+(k-1)/2+beta(k-m)/k+O(h), and curvature -h²/k+O(h³). For p h²->tau>0, uniform Gaussian tail and dominated lattice-sum passage give theta sum indexed by fractional part x_h. Choosing h from g_h prime(N+theta)=0 gives integer/half-integer phase subsequences; Poisson theta formula gives strictly distinct limits. For p->infty, p h²->0, scaled Gaussian Riemann sums give sqrt(2pi k/(p h²)). Independently evaluated exact spectral weights numerically for k=3,m=2,alpha=0.4,tau=8 and two phases: observed 1.536834 vs theta 1.536862 (integer), 1.533098 vs 1.533118 (half-integer). These are checks, not the asymptotic proof.
